metadata.summary: Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked a 49-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Houston Texans to a 34-31 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in a thriller at Wembley Stadium on Sunday.
metadata.content: NFL London games 2026: Houston Texans beat Jacksonville Jaguars after Ka'imi Fairbairn's walk-off field goal | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL London games 2026: Houston Texans beat Jacksonville Jaguars after Ka'imi Fairbairn's walk-off field goal CJ Stroud throws three touchdown passes as the Houston Texans beat the Jacksonville Jaguars thanks to a game-winning field goal from Ka'imi Fairbairn in the final seconds at Wembley Stadium; Travis Hunter records touchdown and interception for Jaguars By Cam Hogwood at Wembley Stadium Sunday 18 October 2026 19:05, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Houston Texans against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley from Week 6 of the NFL season. Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked a 49-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Houston Texans to a 34-31 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in a thriller at Wembley Stadium on Sunday. It was a game that began with referee Larry Smith being carted off with a non-contact injury in the opening seconds. A game that spent its interval staging on-field Corgi races. And a game that concluded with another dose of boot-fuelled drama following Cam Little's last-second winner against the Philadelphia Eagles at Tottenham the previous week. Texans quarterback CJ Stroud threw for 312 yards and three touchdowns while Jaylin Noel led his side with four receptions for 107 yards and a score as Houston improved to 2-4 on the year. metadata.summary: Northampton became the first Gallagher Prem team to win in the Investec Champions Cup this season as they earned a hard-fought 28-12 victory over Cardiff.

Northampton became the first Gallagher Prem team to win in the Investec Champions Cup this season as they earned a hard-fought 28-12 victory over Cardiff. After seven failed attempts from their fellow English sides, the Prem champions were pushed hard by their Welsh visitors, who at one time threatened a comeback at DPD Stadium at Franklin's Gardens. It took a vital try from man of the match George Hendy to regain control for Saints as they restored some pride on what has been a bruising weekend for teams from their league.
